title: The risk-limit tests never run the production risk SQL on production-shaped rows: db.test.ts runs re-typed copies of the exposure and daily-loss queries with sell amounts stored as decimal ETH, and riskManager.test.ts mocks the statements, so the registered unit-mismatch and failed-held exclusion defects pass green

evidence.note: GET_TOTAL_EXPOSURE_SQL and GET_DAILY_LOSS_SQL are re-typed inside the test ("SQL for getTotalExposure ...")
the exposure and daily-loss cases insert sell rows with amount_out "0.03" / "0.02" and gas_cost "0.0005" (decimal ETH) and run the copies
the real getTotalExposure / getDailyRealizedLoss subtract CAST(amount_out) from CAST(amount_in); never executed by a unit test
production sell rows get amountOut = the WETH wad as a wei bigint string, not decimal ETH (AUD-DB-002)
getOpenPositionCount, getTotalExposure and getDailyRealizedLoss are vi.fn statements
the daily-loss and exposure cases feed total_loss -0.15 and total 9.96 (decimal) straight into canSnipe
canSnipe compares the statement result to the decimal threshold

sibling_sites_checked: Every unit test of risk, P&L and exposure: db.test.ts (copies of getPnL, getTotalExposure, getDeployedCapitalByChain, getDailyRealizedLoss, getPnLChartData at :170-282), riskManager.test.ts (statements mocked, getPortfolioExposure fed decimal deployed values), positionsHelper.test.ts (getPnL mocked). bot/* tests mock riskManager entirely. No unit test inserts a row the way bot.ts (decimal amount_in) and exitEngine.ts (wei amount_out from receiptDecoder) do and then runs the real statement.
severity_rationale: S2: the tests claim the daily-loss breaker and exposure cap work (risk limits are capital controls) while the registered S1s AUD-DB-002 (unit mismatch) and AUD-DB-003 (failed-held positions excluded from status=pending) pass green; the fixtures encode the wrong-unit assumption.
recommendation: Phase 28 (after the AUD-DB-002 fix in Phase 24): seed a temp DB through the real write paths (insertTrade as bot.ts and exitEngine.ts call it, with a decoded wei amountOut) and run the real db.ts statements and canSnipe on it; delete the SQL copies.
affected_cases: getDailyRealizedLoss: partial sell profit offsets later loss (D-05)
riskManager.test.ts: returns {allowed:false, reason:"daily_loss_limit"} when daily loss exceeded
riskManager.test.ts: returns {allowed:false, reason:"exposure_cap"} when total exposure exceeded
escaped_regression: Today's code already escapes (AUD-DB-002): a sell row stores the WETH wad in wei, so the daily loss computed by db.ts:441-459 is a huge positive number and the breaker never fires, while every case stays green. A concrete change that also stays green: edit getDailyRealizedLoss at src/utils/db.ts:441-459 in any way (for example drop the "< 0" filter); the copy in db.test.ts:238 is what runs.
